ana-fin: Heads-up: small A/B rollout leak — a vendor sheet change caused two customers to be billed at experiment rates instead of their preserved tiers. getting support tickets.

ryan-ops: Which invoices?

ana-fin: INV-2025-07-20-3301 and INV-2025-07-20-3302; custs: PIONEER-3, PIONEER-4. Looks like `preserve_legacy` column was renamed to `keep_price`.

mei-eng: We deployed the new ingest yesterday. it should accept aliases but the alias table missed `keep_price`. opening a quick patch.

dario-revops: confirm experiment service still returns bucket=legacy for those customers?

billing-bot: experiment service: PIONEER-3 -> legacy, PIONEER-4 -> legacy.

ryan-ops: I'll run a scoped reingest dry-run and simulate credits. ETA 20m. plan: dry-run -> review -> apply.

ryan-ops: Dry-run output:
```
2025-07-21T08:10:01Z INFO reading 2 rows from vendor file
2025-07-21T08:10:02Z INFO PIONEER-3 preserve_legacy=true after alias mapping
2025-07-21T08:10:03Z INFO INV-2025-07-20-3301 -> credit $7.35 queued (dry-run)
2025-07-21T08:10:04Z INFO PIONEER-4 preserve_legacy=true after alias mapping
2025-07-21T08:10:05Z INFO INV-2025-07-20-3302 -> no credit (promo)
```

mei-eng: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/price-ingest/pulls/401 — adds `keep_price` alias and an import warning for unmapped headers.

dario-revops: Draft message for customers: "We regret a temporary billing discrepancy caused by a vendor file header change. We've applied an account credit where appropriate; no action required. Contact billing@redwood.ai for questions." Lara OK with wording?

lara-legal: change "we regret" -> "we apologize" and remove any wording that suggests contractual change. include escalation to legal for refund requests > $1000.

dario-revops: updated. Will send after credits applied.

ryan-ops: Live reingest kicked off at 08:30 UTC; command `./backfill --rows 3301,3302`

billing-bot: Credits applied: INV-2025-07-20-3301 -> $7.35 (account credit). INV-2025-07-20-3302 -> no-op (promo). Status: completed.

ana-fin: Thanks. Mei: merge the alias PR after CI. Ryan: add a temporary pre-import alias check to the rollout checklist for the next 3 vendor imports. I'll open a short postmortem capturing root cause and action items. :white_check_mark:
